Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public. 




Mazdoor Kisan Shakti Sangathan 
"The Right to Information, The Right to Live"

1. Scope — Recommends the proforma for purchase specification for horizontal/universal knee-type 
milling machines. It also gives essential information about the horizonal/universal knee-type milling 
machines and their accessories which will enable the user to assess the usefulness and suitability fcr 
requirements.

EXPLANATORY NOTE 

The proforma for purchase speciiications for machine tools has been prepared to enable 
a prospective buyer to collect data from various manufacturers/suppliers for purposes of comparison. 
This proforma is meant to be sent out with an enquiry by the purchaser so that the manufacturers/ 
suppliers can fill in the data and send it back to the purchaser to make the comparison easier for the 
purchaser. 



to the following Indian Standards in this standard: 

Colours for ready mixed paints ( third revisioh ) 
Dimensions for T-slot ( second revision ) 
Specification for coolant pumps for machine tools 
Test chart for horizontal and universal milling machines 
Spacing for T-sIots ( second revision ) 

Degrees of protection provided by enclosures for rotating electrical machniery 
Measurement and evaluation of vibration of rotating electrical machines 
Dimensions for self release 7/24 tapers for spindle noses for milling machines 
Specification for milling arbors with self release 7/24 taper 
Principles of mechanical guarding of machinery 

Method of measuring noise from machine tools ( excluding testing in anechoic 
chambers ) 

This standard was first published in 1973. The Committee responsbile for' formulation of this 
standard decided to revise the same based upon experience gained. In the present revision require- 
ments of motors and coolant pumps, and requirements for environmental and safety aspects have also 
been included in the proforma.
